entities.name: BH RLC channel release procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing BH RLC channels and associated entities when triggered by bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList or SCG release.

entities.name: bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList
entities.description: List containing BH-RLC-ChannelID values to be released as part of current IAB-node configuration within the same cell group.

entities.name: BH-RLC-ChannelID
entities.description: Identifier for a Backhaul RLC channel.

entities.name: SCG release
entities.description: Secondary Cell Group release procedure that triggers BH RLC channel release.

entities.name: RLC entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity that must be released according to TS 38.322, clause 5.1.3.

entities.name: logical channel
entities.description: Logical channel corresponding to the BH RLC channel that must be released.

relations.description: BH RLC channel release procedure uses the bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList to identify channels for release.
SCG release triggers the BH RLC channel release procedure.
BH RLC channel release procedure results in release of RLC entities.
BH RLC channel release procedure results in release of corresponding logical channels.
